limitations.detail: Dual signing required: HMAC-SHA256 API-key headers (secret is base64-encoded before HMAC, signature output base64) PLUS a zkLink L2 payload signature (seeds/l2Key) inside the request body for orders, transfers and withdrawals â template cannot express L2 body signing
Signature message = APEX-TIMESTAMP + HTTP method + request path (query appended for GET) + alphabetically sorted body string; timestamp is ISO/current unix per docs

Public REST paths (/v3/klines, /v3/depth, /v3/ticker, /v3/symbols) not printed verbatim in corpus; derived from SDK method names klines_v3/depth_v3/ticker_v3/configs_v3 and nav entries 'GET Candlestick Chart Data', 'GET Market Depth', 'GET Ticker Data', 'GET All Config Data' â verify at runtime
Kline/depth/ticker response envelope and field names not documented in provided pages; field_map t/o/h/l/c/v follows ApeX convention â verify at runtime
Symbol format inconsistent: public REST SDK examples use 'BTCUSDT' (no separator) while WebSocket topics, order placement and positions use 'BTC-USDT'
Kline start/end params are unix seconds per SDK example (1718358480); response timestamps (createdAt etc.) are milliseconds
MARKET orders require an explicit price field (zkLink signing); obtain via GET /v3/get-worst-price or top-of-book

Types: LIMIT, MARKET, STOP_LIMIT, STOP_MARKET, TAKE_PROFIT_LIMIT, TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET; timeInForce GOOD_TIL_CANCEL/FILL_OR_KILL/IMMEDIATE_OR_CANCEL/POST_ONLY; required body includes limitFee and expiration (recommend 28 days); clientOrderId required

USDT-settled perpetual futures: per-contract initialMarginRate/maintenanceMarginRate, customInitialMarginRate, liquidation engine; funding exchanged every 1 hour with real-time fluctuating rate â interest_per_4h_pct not applicable
min_order_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
max leverage not documented (initial margin rate user-configurable per contract) â using default max_risk_coef 3.0
qty_step not documented globally; per-symbol stepSize/tickSize available from config endpoint (USDT tick size 6 decimals) â using default 8
price_band_pct not documented â using default 5.0
min_collateral_usdt/max_collateral_usdt not documented â using defaults 10.0/100000.0
Fees are account-level: takerFeeRate 0.00050 / makerFeeRate 0.00020 shown in docs examples; fee_pct set to taker 0.05% per side
Rate limits: 600 req/60s per IP, 300 POST and 600 GET per 60s per account, 200 open orders per user; per-endpoint limits referenced but not detailed in corpus
